Level 1: Unstable Bombs
The Alchemist can create an Unstable Bomb to be used with the Bomb Throw as part of the action itself.
Unstable Bomb: As you commit to the Bomb Throw action, choose one of the following effects:
Area: 3-units cube
Choose acid or fire. Roll Bomb Throw against Deflection. Threshold is 1.
Any creature within the area that you've
succeeded against receives 1 damage of the type you chose.
Area: 3-units cube
The area is filled with purple smoke. Creatures in the smoke cannot see outside of it and have half cover against ranged attacks of any kind.

Level 1: Curious Concoctions
You start each day with 4 Concoction points. At level 1, choose four options from the 'Concoctions Options' section below.
You may create any of those Concoctions by using the required points. The Concoctions are only good for the current day, after which they lose their effect. You can't create concoctions during combat (it takes a few minutes to create a concoction).
As you level up, you will gain more points, unlock new options, and choose more of them.
Multiple uses of the same concoction don't stack.

subclasses.Description: You deploy and improvise clockwork "toys" and mechanisms that are both useful and deadly.
subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
You deploy and improvise clockwork "toys" and mechanisms that are both useful and deadly.
Level 3: Mechanist
You become Expert (5d6) in Mechanics.
If you were already Adept (4d6) in Mechanics, you become Adept (4d6) in any other standard skill from the knowledge category instead.
If you were already Expert (5d6) in Mechanics, you become Adept (4d6) in one knowledge skill and one other standard skill of your choice.
Level 3: Mechanism Points
You start each day with 3 Mechanism Points (Shown as MP throughout the following descriptions). You may create Mechanisms from the options below by using the required points. The Mechanisms are only good for the current day, after which they fall apart. Some mechanisms cannot be created during combat.
As you level up, you will gain more points and unlock new options.
Instinct Abilities
• Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Dice.
• Evade: When you are attacked, gain +1 Deflection against the attack.
• Still Mind: When you are attacked, gain +1 Will against the attack.
Level 3: Mechanism Options?
The following mechanisms can be created using Mechanism Points (MP):
Available to choose from Level 3
Constructs
Clockwork Walker 
Costs 1 MP
Tiny, 1 HP, movement 3.
In combat, acts as a separate actor that you control in the same manner as your character. It makes clicking noises when it is active. You have advantage on Sneak against NPCs who are rolling the walker.
Activate the walker by using a Fast Action or by spending 1 Instinct during the Beginning Phase.
After two rounds of combat, or twelve seconds, it becomes disabled.
When you build the walker, choose its function. You may also modify it to fit a different function later.
Function
Jumper: It can use a Fast Action to jump up to two units towards the face of an opponent of a large or smaller size. It distracts them, providing advantage on attacks against them for the same round. After the action, the walker is disabled.
Bomb Carrier: You can put any one bomb in it (you need to provide the bomb from elsewhere). It can use a Fast Action to detonate, destroying itself in the process. The effect of the detonation is according to the bomb's description.
Traps
Beartrap
Costs 1 MP
Large or smaller creatures that step on the trap receive 1 Piercing damage and become Slowed (1 Drag and -1 Movement) until the end of the next round.
Equipment
Jumping Boots
Costs 1 MP
These crude boots are worn on top of the user's own boots. As part of the wearer's movement, they may jump forward using the boots, moving them 3 units in a straight line in addition to their normal movement. They can also be used to jump 2 units higher as part of a vertical jump. The boots are destroyed after one use.
Putting the boots on is a Slow Action.

subclasses.Description: Paint the battlefield red using outstanding weapon techniques.
subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
Paint the battlefield red using outstanding weapon techniques.
Level 3: Who Needs a Shield
Your incredible technique with weapons allows you to deflect attack as effectively as if you were using a shield. Get +1 Deflection when you hold at least one weapon and no shield.
Level 3: Basic Dual Wielding
You may wield two one-handed weapons, provided no more than one has the Heavy property. When you perform a Melee Strike using both weapons, make one attack roll and apply the following:
• Add the Extra Dice from both weapons to the roll.
• Use the higher of the two weapons' Minimum Roll values.
• Choose one damage type available to either weapon.
• If you roll a double six, choose and apply the Double 6 effect of one weapon.
Level 3: Bloody Momentum
When you kill an enemy with a Melee Strike, you get 1 more instinct until the end of the round.

subclasses.Description: Dominate the battlefield with unwavering presence.
subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
Dominate the battlefield with unwavering presence.
Level 3: Overwatch
You have 1 more Instinct.
Level 3: None Shall Escape
You may trigger Opportunity Attacks as if your melee reach was larger by 1 unit. If you do so, move 1 unit towards the target, bringing them into your melee reach.
Level 3: Defender Strikes
You gain the following options to Tactical Strike
Challenge: The target suffers disadvantage on all attacks against targets other than you until the end of the next round.

subclasses.Description: Infuse occult magic into your fighting.
subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
Infuse occult magic into your fighting.
Level 3: Occult Spellcasting
You are Expert (5d6) in Magic.
You can use the Magic skill to:
Can cast Occult Cantrips.
Can cast Occult Spells using Spell Points.
Spell Points: 2 / Day (must rest to regain)
Spells Learned: 2 Occult Spells
Cantrips Learned: 2 Occult Cantrips.
Witchblade unlocks Rank 1 spells at level 3, Rank 2 at level 6, and Rank 3 at level 9.
Level 3: Eldritch Tactics
You gain the following options to Tactical Strike
Condemn (penalty of 2 on the roll): The target becomes Vulnerable (-1 to all defenses) until the end of the next round.
Sicken: The target becomes Disoriented (1 penalty on all rolls) until the end of the next round.
You may cast occult spells and cantrips even if you don't have a free hand, by channeling the spell through your weapon.
In addition, you may use the Opportunity Attack and Counterstrike features using a cantrip with a range of Touch instead of Melee Strike.
Level 3: Student of the Dark
You can use the Student of War feature against abominations and fiends as well as humanoids.
Level ?: Mutant Body
One minute after drinking a potion, you get advantage on the first Melee Strike you make. You can get this advantage only once per combat.
Level ?: Vile Slash
You gain the following action:
Vile Slash — Melee Strike Variant
Cost: 1 / Combat
Perform a Melee Strike. Gain 2 Extra Dice on the roll, or 4 Extra Dice against a fiend or abomination. The strike's damage type becomes Necrotic or Acid (your choice).

subclasses.Description: Play with the mind of your enemies, using enchantments and illusions that dance around the line of reality itself.
subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
Play with the mind of your enemies, using enchantments and illusions that dance around the line of reality itself.
Level 3: Elusive
You gain the following Instinct ability:
Instinct Abilities
Mind Games: At any point during the round, cast an Illusion spell. The spell costs 1 additional Spell Point when cast this way.
Level 3: Fracture Reality
You gain 1 Fracture Spell Point at the beginning of combat. It can only be used to cast spells that are rolled against Will.
When you cast a spell using the Fracture Spell Point, choose one of the following:
Double: if it only has one target, you may immediately perform it again against a second target. You need to spend Spell Points on this additional casting.
Extend: If the spell has a duration, you may increase the duration until the end of the combat
You lose the Fracture Spell Point at the end of combat if you have not spent it.

A cantrip that deals damage and normally has Average speed has Fast speed for you instead.

At the beginning of combat, you gain 1 Evocation Spell Point. It may only be used to cast a spell that deals damage. When you cast a spell using the Evocation Spell Point, it counts as if you spent 1 additional Spell Point on that spell. At the end of combat, you lose the Evocation Spell Point if you have not spent it.

subclasses.Description: Your rage erupts as chaotic fire, consuming you and everything that stands in your path.
subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
Your rage erupts as chaotic fire, consuming you and everything that stands in your path.

Level 3: Infernal Rage Aura
During the Beginning Phase of each round, you may activate or deactivate your aura. While it is active, at the end of each round, you and every other creature within 1 unit of you take 1 Fire damage automatically, without a roll. The damage to yourself cannot be mitigated. Gain 1 additional Rage for each other creature that takes damage this way. This stacks with your normal Rage gains from damaging enemies. Damage to yourself grants Rage only through the normal rule for losing HP, with no additional Rage from this feature.

Level 3: Hot Retaliation
When an enemy within 6 units of you attacks you, you may spend 1 Instinct to deal 1 Fire damage to yourself and 2 Fire damage to that enemy. The damage to yourself cannot be mitigated. Gain 1 additional Rage for each other creature that takes damage this way. This stacks with your normal Rage gains from damaging enemies. Damage to yourself grants Rage only through the normal rule for losing HP, with no additional Rage from this feature.

Level 3: Flaming Strikes
When you perform a Melee Strike or Unarmed Strike, you may spend additional Rage to extend its range by 1 unit for each Rage spent. If you spend Rage this way, the Strike deals Fire damage instead of its normal damage type.

Level 3: Ultimate: Fiery Eruption
Slow Action; costs 8 Rage.
Spend 8 Rage to unleash flames on every other creature within 2 units of you. You are not affected. Roll Athletics once and compare the result against each target's Deflection. On success, the target takes 2 Fire damage and is force-pushed 1 unit away from you. On failure, it takes half as much damage, rounded down, and is not pushed.

subclasses.Description: Your bloodlust drives your body beyond its limits, turning every battle into a relentless display of violence.
subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
Your bloodlust drives your body beyond its limits, turning every battle into a relentless display of violence.

Level 3: Bloodlust
When you kill an enemy with Weapon Throw, or an enemy dies within your melee range, you gain 2 temporary hit points. Each enemy's death grants this benefit only once, even if both conditions apply.

Level 3: Limit Break
At any point during the round, you may spend 1 Instinct and lose 2 HP to immediately perform a Melee Strike, Unarmed Strike, Grapple, or Weapon Throw, including any of their variants available to you. The chosen action or variant retains its normal costs, requirements, and usage limits.

Level 3: Ultimate: Whirlwind
Special Action; Fast; costs 5 Rage.
Spend 5 Rage to perform a Melee Strike against every enemy within your melee range. Roll Melee once and compare the result against each target's Deflection. Apply your normal Melee Strike damage and effects to each target: full damage on success, or half as much damage on failure, rounded down. If you roll a Double 6, apply your usual Melee Strike Double 6 effects to each target, regardless of whether the roll succeeds against it.

Hardwall
Passive feature
You gain proficiency with Heavy Armor.

Mechanical Expert
Passive feature
You become Expert (5d6) in Mechanics.

Deployment
Passive feature
Use the Deploy Instinct ability to become deployed. While deployed:
• You gain +1 Deflection and +1 Fortitude.
• You may use Ballista abilities.
• You may use only ranged weapons and bombs.
• You provide Half Cover to adjacent creatures of your size and Full Cover to adjacent creatures smaller than you.
• You cannot move.
• You cannot use the Evade Instinct ability.

Deploy
Instinct Ability ◆ 1 Instinct
Spend 1 Instinct to become deployed.

Undeploy
Instinct Ability ◆ 1 Instinct
Spend 1 Instinct to stop being deployed.

Power Shot
Ranged Strike Variant / Ballista ability ◆ Slow Action ◆ 1 AP; must be deployed
While deployed, spend 1 AP to perform a Ranged Strike. Double the Extra Dice granted by your weapon for this roll.

Bomb Slinging
Bomb Throw Variant / Ballista ability ◆ Average Action ◆ Must be deployed
While deployed, perform a Bomb Throw with an effective range of 6 units and a maximum range of 12 units. For this action, treat your Bomb Throw skill as Expert (5d6), unless your skill level is already higher.

Caltrops
Ranged Strike Variant / Ballista ability ◆ Average Action ◆ 1 AP; must be deployed
While deployed, spend 1 AP to scatter caltrops throughout a 2-unit radius centered on yourself. The area becomes difficult terrain. Once per turn, when a creature first moves within or enters the area during the round, it must roll Acrobatics against threshold 2. On failure, it takes 1 Piercing damage.
subclasses.Notes: WIP: AP costs and individual feature unlock levels are provisional; these subclasses may be included in build assessments. No final progression beyond level 3 is assigned. Caltrops duration, removal, trigger wording, and variant classification remain unresolved.

subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
Moving Target
Passive feature
When you finish moving at least 3 units from where you started that movement, you gain +1 Deflection until the end of the round. You also become Expert (5d6) in Acrobatics.

Combat Archery
Passive feature
Your Ranged Strikes do not suffer disadvantage from being within an enemy's melee reach, and enemies gain no benefit from Half Cover against them.

Multishot
Ranged Strike Variant / Trick Shot ◆ Fast Action ◆ 1 AP
Spend 1 AP to perform a Ranged Strike against two enemies using the same roll. You deal half your normal Ranged Strike damage to each target, rounded up.

Quickshot
Instinct Ability ◆ 1 Instinct; 1 AP
At any point during the round, spend 1 Instinct and 1 AP to perform a Ranged Strike. You deal half your normal Ranged Strike damage, rounded up.

Countershot
Instinct Ability ◆ 1 Instinct
When an enemy attacks you or an ally within your weapon's effective range, you may spend 1 Instinct to fire a distracting projectile at the attacker. Its attack has disadvantage. If the attack is a Ranged Strike, you intercept its projectile and cancel the attack instead.
subclasses.Notes: WIP: AP costs and individual feature unlock levels are provisional; these subclasses may be included in build assessments. No final progression beyond level 3 is assigned. Combat Archery may move to the base class. Sliding Shot remains with the base class pending a decision. Multishot target-specific advantage/disadvantage and reduced-damage failure handling remain unresolved.

subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
Arcane Expertise
Passive feature
You become Expert (5d6) in Arcana.

Elemental Archery
Passive feature
Whenever you perform a Ranged Strike, you may change its damage type to Fire, Ice, or Lightning. If you do, replace the weapon's Double 6 effect for that Strike with the corresponding effect from Elemental Flare:
• Fire: the target becomes Burning 1 until the end of the round (it takes 1 Fire damage at the end of the round).
• Ice: the target becomes Chilled 2 (-2 Movement) until the end of the next round.
• Lightning: the target becomes Disoriented 1 (a penalty of 1 on all rolls) until the end of the next round.

Force Arrow
Special / Trick Shot ◆ Average Action ◆ 1 AP (provisional)
Spend 1 AP to fire a magical arrow that hits automatically. Roll Ranged without the Extra Dice granted by your weapon, and deal SD Force damage.

Exploding Arrow
Special / Trick Shot ◆ Average Action ◆ 2 AP
Spend 2 AP to fire an arrow that explodes in a cube measuring 2 units on each side. Roll Ranged once and compare the result against each enemy's Deflection in the area. On success, it takes 2 Fire damage. On failure, it takes half as much damage, rounded down.

Thunder Arrow
Trick Shot ◆ Average Action ◆ 2 AP
Spend 2 AP to fire an arrow that releases a thunderous blast in a cube measuring 3 units on each side. Roll Ranged once and compare the result against each enemy's Deflection in the area. On success, an enemy of your size or smaller becomes Prone.

Ice-Surfing
Instinct Ability ◆ 1 Instinct
Spend 1 Instinct to freeze a path beneath you and slide along it as you move. Gain +2 Movement until the end of the round.

Arcane Shield
Instinct Ability ◆ 1 Instinct; 2 AP
At any point during the round, spend 1 Instinct and 2 AP to gain +2 Deflection and immunity to the Magic Missile spell until the end of the round.

subclasses.Description: You wield curses and corrupting magic to weaken your enemies and make their suffering linger.
subclasses.Full Features / Rules:
You wield curses and corrupting magic to weaken your enemies and make their suffering linger.

Level 3: Bonus Cantrip
You learn Necrotic Bolt. If you already know it, learn another Occult cantrip of your choice.

Level 3: Hexcraft
Instinct Ability
When you apply Vulnerable, Poisoned, Decayed, or Weakened to an enemy, you may spend 1 Instinct to choose one of those conditions that you just applied and do one of the following:
• Spread: Apply the chosen condition at the same level to up to two other enemies within 3 units of the original enemy. It lasts until the end of the next round on those enemies.
• Intensify: Increase the chosen condition's level on the original enemy by 1, keeping its existing duration.

Level 3: Vile Spell Point
At the beginning of each combat, you gain 1 Vile Spell Point. You may spend it only to cast or empower a spell that applies negative conditions. When you spend this point on a spell, increase the level of every negative condition applied by that spell by 1. This increase applies to conditions that have levels. At the end of combat, you lose the Vile Spell Point if you have not spent it.

When you become Dying, you die when you get 3 death rolls failures instead of 2.

Learn two non-exotic languages.

Long rest removes two levels of Exhaustion instead of one.

You gain the following Instinct abilities:

You may use Deception, instead of Insight, to determine whether someone lies. (It doesn't replace other uses of Insight, such as deeper understanding of emotions)

People assume you are a noble (unless you do something that gives away that you might not be one).

At any time, you may adopt another pet to replace the one you have (or if it died).

• Push Through (1 / Day): At any time during the Action Phase of the round, roll 4d6 and heal SD.

You are proficient with two selected tools of your choice.
Repeatable: you may choose this feat additional times. Choose a additional tools each time you do.
You may use Sleight of Hand instead of Mechanics to disarm traps.
